findings.title: The chosen plan is marked only by a thin outline

location.description: The three plan cards under the Plan heading, where Full gym is the chosen plan.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer cannot tell at a glance which plan the gym is on, because the chosen card differs from the other two only by a thin teal outline and a filled dot in a small radio button.

current.value: The chosen plan card has a one-pixel teal outline and a small filled radio dot; its text and background match the other two cards.

findings.target: The chosen plan reads as chosen from arm's length, by more than a thin outline and a small dot.
findings.fix_direction: Mark the current plan so that it is the first thing the eye finds among the three cards.
findings.source: Nielsen, 10 Usability Heuristics, visibility of system status

closed_when.check: Look at the three plan cards and check that the chosen plan can be told from the other two without reading the radio buttons.

findings.title: Invoice amounts sit far from the plan names they belong to

location.description: The Invoices table at the bottom of the page.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer's eye has to travel a wide empty gap to match a plan name with its amount.

current.value: The Plan column ends near the middle of the table and the Amount column sits at the far right, with a wide empty gap between them.

findings.target: The plan name and its amount can be read as one row without losing the line.
findings.fix_direction: Bring the amount closer to the plan it belongs to, or make the row easier to follow across the gap.

closed_when.check: Look at one invoice row and check that the plan and the amount can be read as one row without losing the line.
